title: Page statistics
statementMd:
Show the minimum, maximum and average page count across all books (average rounded to 1 decimal).

Expected columns: `shortest`, `longest`, `average`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT MIN(pages) AS shortest, MAX(pages) AS longest, ROUND(AVG(pages), 1) AS average FROM books;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
